Container.Name: Pipe-Bomb
Container.Overview: A self-hosted music streaming platform with a plugin system, flexible attribute schema, and an app-quality client. This is the all-in-one image — the API server, frontend, and nginx proxy all run inside a single container.

Branch.TagDescription: Stable release. Recommended for most users.
Bleeding edge build from the master branch. May be unstable.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Port Pipe Bomb will be accessible on.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores its database and core data.

Config.Name: Resources Path
Config.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores resources such as album art and thumbnails.

Config.Name: Audio Cache Path
Config.Description: Where Pipe Bomb caches audio files. Recommended to place on a fast drive (e.g. your cache pool).

Config.Name: Plugin Cache Path
Config.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores plugin-related cache files.

Config.Name: Plugins Path
Config.Description: Where Pipe Bomb loads plugins from.

Config.Name: Temp Path
Config.Description: Where Pipe Bomb writes temporary files. Can safely point to fast or ephemeral storage.

Config.Name: Secrets Path
Config.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores secrets such as the JWT signing key. Keep this on persistent storage.

Config.Name: Music Library Path
Config.Description: Path to your local music library for the local-library plugin.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Only needed if CORS is causing issues. Set to the exact URL you use to access Pipe Bomb (e.g. http://192.168.1.100 or http://pipebomb.local).
